notes.title: Patch Overview
notes.content:
[p]Hello there, fellow Tiny Terrace enjoyers! 🌿🌱🌞 [/p][p]
The game was released yesterday, and here are some things that were fixed over many little patches.

(as of v0.90.634.7070)[/p][p] 🔨Here are some things that I have fixed.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed some missing translations.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed giving a nondescript building at the beginning.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed the sorting tabs in the fellows menu being on top of eachother[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed the levels of the guys not being saved.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed the missing costs of some buildings[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed different-level sprinklers functioning the exact same.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed the ability to hotswap juices so that juice barrel would be harvested for a different juice than was currently being produced.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed beans being unharvestable, so now you should be able to progress past them.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed tutorials not saving (maybe fixed, I should say, it seems to be fixed sometimes, but just recently reverted for me.)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed ponds not loading back in. (They, however, aren't destroyable after loading yet.)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed buildings all having the word seed added to the end of them.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]📃Known Issues:[/p][list][*][p]The progress goal popup is not translated and has some visual issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fellas standing around doing nothing[/p][/*][*][p]Info tab in the journal is not scrollable[/p][/*][*][p]Fellas menu cutting off the bottom-most fella in the list[/p][/*][*][p]Hat UI is broken, and if a hat is equipped it doesn't load back in[/p][/*][*][p]Loading back in sometimes malfunctions, causing a clearing of some amount of your farm. (I think I may have prevented the clearing of farms with some changes to the loading function)[/p][/*][*][p]Seed planting mode, axe tool, and sickle tool, all bound to the same key.[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p]I will continue to patch up the game. Thanks for checking out the game! :D[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Release Update?
notes.content:
[p]Hello there, fellow Tiny Terrace enjoyers! 🌿🌱🌞 [/p][p][/p][p]I've decided to swap the Tiny Terraces full release to an Early Access release. This doesn't mean I'm releasing with any less content, I'm just reclassifying what I consider to be v1.0. The release dates remain the same: July 31st for Steam, August 8th for Mobile(iOS & Android). The game will be released as version 0.9, and I plan to keep it in Early Access for approximately a few months before doing the v1.0 release. 


I know this will make some people sad/mad, sorry about that. But I will continue to develop/update the game, adding even more content to the game as was already intended. I will continue posting videos/shorts to the [url="https://www.youtube.com/c/VuVuuInc"]VuVuu Inc. YouTube channel[/url] throughout the Early Access period (I'll try to target posting some sort of video every few days), so that you can see what's being worked on.

[/p][p]Also, recently, I showed off on the channel that I added a couple of buildings, the [b]Juice Barrel[/b] and [b]Cooking Pot[/b]. 

As the name suggests, the Juice Barrel makes [b]juice which is worth 2x the base product's price[/b]. Currently, it allows processing of all fruits, berries, melons, Coffee beans, Tea leaves, and some vegetables.  [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127895/9842e50e4be2f127b2b3be757a7c251dc40f658d.png"][/img]
[/p][p]And the Cooking Pot currently can process Fruits into [b]Jam worth 2.5x the base product's price[/b], and Fruit Juices into [b]Jelly worth 2x the Juice price[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127895/99901bf08c0f800bcc12779d6735a4a1b29e843b.png"][/img]
[/p][p][b]Thanks for sticking around, and sorry if this announcement disappoints you.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Try the demo if you haven't already! :D[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3289470/Tiny_Terraces/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

 - The Shop will now sell any collected item, so Barley Seeds and birch/pine saplings are now purchasable after being collected once.
 - Destruction mode now swaps to the highest layer which has a destructible object, if there isn't anything on the current sorting layer in that tile.
 - The building move UI now shows at the center of any selected building.
 - Honey produce time adjusted from 60s -> [b]105s[/b]
 - Weather volume is now independent of SFX volume.
 - Seeds don't drop as frequently on plants with multiple regrowths.
 - Made left-side notifications a little larger in vertical mode.
 - Removed some unneeded calculations when the game was not in focus.
 - Adjusted right-side menu scrollbars.
 - Scaled cursor down a little in fullscreen and vertical modes.
 - Removed double click to place a seed or building when the side menu is open.
 - Some performance increases
 - Added a header to inventory and shop menus, which shows the current gold amount.
 - Added sorting tabs to both inventory and shop menus.
 - Added a +/- 100 button to the current sell quantity bar at the bottom of the inventory.
 - Water no longer evaporates from the ground while raining.
 - Fellas no longer spend time watering crops while it's raining.
 - Added link to my Ko-fi page
 - Fixed negative regrowth numbers.
 - Fixed ability to abuse area planting.
 - Fixed the Little Fella scrollbar from skipping over some fellas when scrolling.
 - Fixed watering tiles that already have a sprinkler watering them.
 - Fixed previous building/tile not being deselected when clicking on another object allowing for accidental deletions.
 - Fixed beehive & bee sounds not adjusting volume when there are multiple playing.
 - Fixed area planting with wildflowers from only planting each area with one flower type.
 - Fixed claw on Fella Creator being unlit.
 - (?) Fixed growth sprites, hopefully for the final time.


👷‍♂️📜 Future Update Ideas/Plans.
 - Make Little fellas smart
 - Fix the positioning of the window, which is wrong sometimes.
 - Add day/night progress UI
 - Add Weather UI
 - Work on improving performance.
 - Change pathfinding.
 - Redo Building Destruction
 - Redo Fella Creator UI
 - a little More info on buildings/plants.

notes.title: v0.12.231.1968

Here is a little update for the Tiny Terraces Demo to fix some things & issues found.

 - Beehive produce time upped from: [strike]15s[/strike] -> [b]60s[/b]
 - Honey price changes: Base Honey: 12g -> 8g || Wildflower Honey: 18g -> 14g || Tree Honey: 26g -> 20g
 - Plants now have a certain number of regrowths per plant type. (regrowths cause the plant to return to seed upon harvest and continue growing again).
 - Fixed not being able to move the Fella Creator Building.
 - Carrying is now a higher priority task
 - Some minor performance improvements
 - Added more saving stuff, which should prevent the game from closing without saving.
 - Adjust the scrollbar in side menus.
 - Changed the color of the selected tab in the Little Fella Header to make it more readable
 - Controls are now locked while typing a Little Fella name.
 - Holding Shift will make the camera movement faster.
 - Changed plant detail popup UI slightly
 - Possibly fixed error causing the game to be invisible but still have sound.
